en.headline: Lo says Hospital Authority still has 3,200 nurse vacancies
en.dek: The health chief again rejected claims that local graduates cannot find work, saying about 99 percent of registered-nurse applicants were hired.
body: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said on Sunday that the Hospital Authority still has about 3,200 nurse vacancies, and that claims local graduates are left unemployed after training do not stand up to the figures.

Of nearly 4,000 potential nurse graduates last year, about 3,500 became registered or enrolled nurses and only about 2,500 applied to the Authority, Lo said. Among roughly 2,100 registered-nurse applications, close to 99 percent were hired, with just over 20 people not appointed for various reasons. He said graduates also choose private hospitals, clinics and residential care homes.

Lo described talk that non-locally trained staff are taking jobs from local nurses as slogan-like. Hong Kong has more than 75,000 nurses, of whom more than 30,000 work at the Authority. Only 55 of those public-hospital nurses were trained outside Hong Kong — less than 0.2 percent — and nearly half were on short-term exchanges. Nurses on limited registration number fewer than 30, or under 0.1 percent. He said the Authority employs no non-locally trained psychiatric nurses, and that overseas recruits fill posts that cannot be staffed locally.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：醫管局仍有約3200個護士空缺
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長再指「畢業就失業」說法不成立，註冊護士申請獲聘近99%；非本地培訓護士佔公院不足0.2%。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂周日表示，醫院管理局仍有約3200個護士空缺，並重申護士畢業生「畢業就失業」的說法並不成立。
他指出，去年潛在近4000名護士畢業生當中，約3500人成為註冊或登記護士，實際向醫管局應聘的只有約2500人。以註冊護士為例，約2100宗申請當中近99%獲聘，只有20多人因不同原因未獲聘用。盧寵茂強調並非當局不聘請，而是畢業生亦有自己的選擇，院舍及私家醫院同樣需要護士。
對於有意見指非本地培訓人員「搶飯碗」，盧寵茂形容屬口號式說法。他引述數字指，全港有超過75000名護士，醫管局佔逾30000名，當中只有55名非本地培訓護士，即佔公營醫院護士不足0.2%，近一半屬短期交流；有限度註冊護士不足30人，即不足0.1%。他強調醫管局精神科護士絕無非本地培訓，非本地人員屬補助性質，填補未能聘得本地人員的崗位。
